Definition: Shekem, the name of a Hivite and two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shechem is the name of three men: a son of Shemidah, a son of Gilead whose family is counted in the wilderness, and a son of Hamor the Hivite. The name is shared, and the men are not.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe shared names remind us to read carefully. Three Shechems stand in three different families, and I hold that God knows each one by name.
RelatedPeople: Shechem, Son of Hamor; Shechem, Son of Gilead
